status: PACKAGING STUDY WITH BENCHMARK ACTUATOR BLOCKS — NOT A FITTED, SELECTED OR LOAD-QUALIFIED DESIGN
provenance: Second leg iteration, after Bill's ruling of 2026-11-11 (short legs under a low base, to match the build-target picture). Body numbers are the WB-8 catalog envelope (axis mapping unverified). The base module, the hip placement, the link lengths and every bracket, plate, shaft, bearing, pulley, belt and foot are design-session proposals with assumed densities, not purchased or measured parts. The actuator block is the XL330-M288-T size/mass benchmark; it is not selected.
units: mm, g, deg; body frame: origin at clock bottom centre, +X forward through the face, +Y left, +Z up

body.source: https://www.raycue.com/products/maclock — 80 x 91 x 112 mm, 229 g; W/D/H mapping follows Bill's screenshot
body.interior: unknown; anything inside this envelope is reported as inside-shell volume, not as a clear fit

under_shell_height_mm.provenance: ASSUMED. Scaled by the design session on 2026-11-11 from concepts/raycue-build-target.png against the 112 mm catalog body height: the gap from the table to the underside of the shell reads about half the shell's height. Bill ruled 'Yes, short legs' on 2026-11-11.

build_target_reference_mm.provenance: ASSUMED. Same scaling from the same picture, good to about 20 percent. For comparison only; not requirements.

base.note: Height 27 mm, entirely below the shell (nothing inside the unmeasured shell). The plates are narrower than the shell so the carrier plates can swing; the outboard 7 mm of each J1 case stands proud of the plates under the shell overhang.

actuator.name: XL330-M288-T size/mass benchmark block
actuator.source: https://emanual.robotis.com/docs/en/dxl/x/xl330-m288/ — Dimensions (W x H x D) 20.0 x 34.0 x 26.0 mm; Weight 18 g; read 2026-11-10
actuator.axis_offset_provenance: RECALLED from the ROBOTIS XL330 2D drawing, NOT read. To be replaced by a measurement of the first servo.
actuator.horn_provenance: proposed envelopes for the output horn and the opposite-side idler boss; not read from the drawing
actuator.stall_torque_provenance: CATALOG at 5 V, ROBOTIS store page read 2026-11-10

hip.P1_provenance: design-session placement: J1 case lying flat inside the base (W vertical), 1 mm clear of each base plate, 1 mm clear of the opposite J1 case at the centreline
hip.j2_dx_provenance: H/2 minus the axis offset, so the flat J2 case is centred on x1 and is held by its two end faces between the carrier plates
hip.d_provenance: smallest outboard offset (0.5 mm steps) at which the innermost leg plate clears the J1 case's outboard corner by the clearance while the carrier spreads: sqrt(11^2 + 10^2) + 1.5 = 16.4 mm from the J1 axis

links.length_provenance: equal links for both knee variants; 30 mm keeps the shank's knee case clear of the J2 case's near-end corner for a thigh swinging forward of vertical
links.density_provenance: assumed printed polymer for plates, hubs and channels; not selected

knee.transmission_provenance: proposed GT2-class pulley and belt envelopes and a 5 mm shaft with flanged-bearing envelopes; nothing selected

foot.density_provenance: assumed elastomer roller; a round foot keeps the contact point under the foot axis whatever the shank angle; passive tilt seat not modelled

hardware_allowance_provenance: proposed allowance per joint for fasteners, spacers and output bearing; not counted parts

mass_model.shell_provenance: CATALOG mass of the complete clock, ASSUMED fully retained and uniform in its envelope
mass_model.payload_provenance: ASSUMED: middle of the design review's 150 to 300 g for compute, display, audio, sensors and harness, placed at the body centre
mass_model.battery_provenance: ASSUMED: middle of the design review's 94 to 142 g for two cells, placed inside the shell just above the base; the shell interior is unmeasured
mass_model.reference_mass_provenance: the design review's torque table used 1.0 kg; kept so the two tables compare

poses.stance_rule: b = -c/2; c solved so that the under-shell height equals requirements.under_shell_height_mm.target
poses.reference_pose_provenance: the J04-L02 stance pose, kept so the two iterations compare at the same joint angles
poses.sweep_scope: viewing/search ranges, the same grid as J04-L02; not component or controller limits

candidate_note: Base module under the shell with the four hip-spread actuators lying flat inside it. The hip-swing actuator lies flat beside the base, level with it, held by its end faces. The thigh is two plates. In the direct variant the knee actuator is the shank; in the proximal variant it sits on the hip-swing axis outboard of the thigh and drives the knee by a belt.
